railway.caption: Central Park aerial perspective
railway.description: The park follows the linear grain of the former rail yard, using planted strips, retained traces and new cross-connections to stitch the landscape into its neighbourhood.

railway.caption: Coal Drops Plaza axonometric view
railway.description: Coal Drops Plaza combines generous open space with planted edges and clear routes. Its platform-like organisation recalls railway infrastructure while supporting gathering and movement.

difc.caption: Urban landscape perspective
difc.description: A pedestrian route threads through planting beneath the surrounding buildings, showing how shade and landscape can bring a more intimate scale to the district.

difc.caption: Public realm perspective
difc.description: The public realm connects buildings through paths, planted spaces and places to pause, extending the landscape framework into the everyday experience of the masterplan.

mountain.caption: The Ridge aerial perspective
mountain.description: An elevated view reveals the Ridge within the wider city, emphasising the relationship between its artificial landform and the surrounding urban fabric.

mountain.caption: Mountain landscape perspective
mountain.description: A ground-level perspective places movement and activity within the sculpted slopes, illustrating how the mountain can be experienced as an accessible landscape.

mirage.caption: Resort concept perspective
mirage.description: Monumental columns rise above a planted base, expressing the resort as a rediscovered city whose architecture and landscape are closely intertwined.

mirage.caption: Resort exterior perspective
mirage.description: The Carved City is viewed as a network of planted terraces and water spaces, set below the surrounding dunes and organised around sheltered outdoor experiences.

north-resort.caption: Main pool landscape
north-resort.description: Palms, pool edges and shaded seating frame the main swimming space. The landscape establishes a relaxed guest environment with views through to the wider coastal setting.

north-resort.caption: Wellness village arrival
north-resort.description: A sheltered arrival space brings mature planting into the wellness setting, using shade, seating and framed views to create a calm transition between inside and outside.

marina.caption: Arrival from the marina
marina.description: Planting and a clear arrival forecourt guide guests towards the hotel entrance, beginning the sequence of spaces that leads through the property to the beach.

marina.caption: Adult pool landscape
marina.description: The adult pool is framed by palm planting and low-rise buildings, with the landscape opening towards the coast and connecting swimming, seating and circulation.
